_doc: Source of the Gitta CBOM. Every cryptographic algorithm, protocol, certificate and key Gitta uses, with where it is used. sbom/cbom.py turns this into CycloneDX 1.6 and reads library versions from Cargo.lock. `python3 sbom/cbom.py check` fails when a crypto crate is added to or removed from Cargo.lock, or its version moves past `reviewed`, without a change here.

sha2.role: SHA-256 for the audit hash chain and update verification

digest.role: Digest traits used by sha2 (no algorithm of its own)

crypto-common.role: Common block and output types used by sha2 and digest (no algorithm of its own)

external.curl: System curl, not shipped with Gitta. The CLI calls it for HTTPS to a team server and the identity provider. TLS versions, cipher suites and the default CA store come from the operating system's curl and its TLS library.

usedIn.purpose: Hash chain of the local audit trail: each record holds the SHA-256 of the previous record; `gitta audit verify` checks the chain

protocol.version: as the system curl allows (curl's default minimum is TLS 1.2)

usedIn.purpose: HTTPS to the team server (warnings, audit upload, team commands) and to the identity provider for `gitta login`. Plain http is allowed only when the server address says http

assets.name: X.509 CA certificate for the team server (GITTA_SERVER_CA)

usedIn.purpose: Optional PEM file passed to curl --cacert so the CLI trusts a team server with a private certificate authority. Without it, the system CA store is used

material.format: gt1_ personal token or admin token, sent as an HTTP Authorization: Bearer header

usedIn.purpose: Authenticates the CLI to the team server. The CLI only sends it; the server checks it
